```{r}
library(tbeptools)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(sf)
source(here("R", "funcs.R"))

```

Indicators:
* Water Quality
    * chla, water clarity
    * loading
    * tidal creeks
    * FIBs
* Sediment
    * TBBI/AMBI
    * PEL/TEL
* Fish/Wildlife
    * TBNI
    * Nonnatives
* Habitat
    * Seagrass
    * LULC change/habitat report card

```{r}
# wq
avedat <- anlz_avedat(epcdata)
wqtarg <- avedat |>
  anlz_attain() |>
  separate(chl_la, into = c("chl", "la"), sep = "_") |> 
  mutate(across(c(chl, la), as.numeric)) |>
  mutate(
    totsum = chl + la,
    outcome = 1 - scales::rescale(totsum, to = c(0, 1))
  )
wqthrs <- avedat$ann |>
    dplyr::left_join(targets, by = 'bay_segment') |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      bay_segment = factor(bay_segment, levels = c('OTB', 'HB', 'MTB', 'LTB')),
      outcome = dplyr::case_when(
        var == 'mean_chla' & val < chla_thresh ~ 1,
        var == 'mean_chla' & val >= chla_thresh ~ 0,
        var == 'mean_la' & val < la_thresh ~ 1,
        var == 'mean_la' & val >= la_thresh ~ 0
      )
    ) |> 
    select(yr, bay_segment, var, outcome)

# loading
totanndat <- rdataload("https://github.com/tbep-tech/load-estimates/raw/main/data/totanndat.RData")

segcrsswk <- c(
  'Old Tampa Bay' = 'OTB',
  'Hillsborough Bay' = 'HB',
  'Middle Tampa Bay' = 'MTB',
  'Lower Tampa Bay' = 'LTB'
)
tntarg <- tibble(
  bay_segment = factor(segcrsswk, levels = segcrsswk),
  tn_load_thresh = c(486, 1451, 799, 349),
  tnhy_thresh = c(1.08, 1.62, 1.24, 0.97)
)
tndat <- totanndat |>
  filter(bay_segment %in% names(segcrsswk)) |>
  mutate(bay_segment = factor(segcrsswk[bay_segment], levels = segcrsswk)) |>
  select(year, bay_segment, tn_load, hy_load, tnhy) |>
  left_join(tntarg, by = 'bay_segment') |>
  mutate(
    outcomeld = as.integer(tn_load > tn_load_thresh),
    outcomehy = as.integer(tnhy > tnhy_thresh)
  )

# tidal creeks
trnds <- tibble(
    yrs = 1975:2024,
  ) |> 
  group_nest(yrs) |> 
  mutate(
    data = purrr::map(yrs, function(x){
      # cat(x, '\t')
      anlz_tdlcrk(tidalcreeks, iwrraw, yr = x)
    }) 
  )

# assign each tidal creek to a bay segment based on the tbsegdetail
# subwatershed it overlaps, using length of overlap to pick a segment for
# creeks that span more than one subwatershed
tcseg <- tidalcreeks |>
  st_transform(st_crs(tbsegshed)) |>
  select(id) |>
  st_intersection(tbsegshed |> select(bay_segment)) |>
  mutate(complen = st_length(geometry)) |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  group_by(id) |>
  slice_max(complen, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(id, bay_segment)

tctrnds <- trnds |>
  unnest('data') |>
  inner_join(tcseg, by = 'id')

# condense the categorical creek scores into a single 0-1 value per bay
# segment and year (1 = best); creeks with 'No Data' are dropped from the
# calculation, and each creek record is weighted by its physical length so
# longer creek segments contribute proportionally more to the segment score
crkwts <- c(
  'Prioritize'  = 0,
  'Investigate' = 1/3,
  'Caution'     = 2/3,
  'Monitor'     = 1
)

tcscr <- tctrnds |>
  left_join(
    tidalcreeks |> st_drop_geometry() |> select(id, Creek_Length_m),
    by = 'id'
  ) |>
  filter(score %in% names(crkwts)) |>
  mutate(scoreval = crkwts[score]) |>
  group_by(bay_segment, yrs) |>
  summarise(
    outcome = weighted.mean(scoreval, w = Creek_Length_m, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_assessed = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

# fibs
fibscr <- anlz_fibmatrix(enterodata, bay_segment = c('OTB', 'HB', 'MTB', 'LTB', 'BCB', 'MR')) |>
  mutate(
    outcome = case_when(
      cat == 'E' ~ 0,
      cat == 'D' ~ 1/4,
      cat == 'C' ~ 2/4,
      cat == 'B' ~ 3/4,
      cat == 'A' ~ 1
    )
  )
```

```{r}
# combine all water quality indicators into a single long-format object of
# bay_segment, year, indicator, and a 0-1 outcome (1 = best). coverage of
# bay segments and years differs by indicator, so this stacks the
# indicators (bind_rows) rather than joining them - a segment/year missing
# from an indicator's source data simply has no row for it, rather than an
# NA-filled one. tn_load/hy_load are flipped (1 - outcomeld/outcomehy) so
# 1 = attains target, matching the "1 = best" direction of every other
# indicator here
wqindic <- bind_rows(
  wqtarg |>
    transmute(
      bay_segment = as.character(bay_segment),
      yr = as.integer(yr),
      indicator = 'wq_attain',
      outcome
    ),
  wqthrs |>
    filter(var %in% c('mean_chla', 'mean_la')) |>
    transmute(
      bay_segment = as.character(bay_segment),
      yr = as.integer(yr),
      indicator = recode(var, mean_chla = 'chla_thresh', mean_la = 'la_thresh'),
      outcome
    ),
  tndat |>
    transmute(
      bay_segment = as.character(bay_segment),
      yr = as.integer(year),
      indicator = 'tn_load',
      outcome = 1 - outcomeld
    ),
  tndat |>
    transmute(
      bay_segment = as.character(bay_segment),
      yr = as.integer(year),
      indicator = 'hy_load',
      outcome = 1 - outcomehy
    ),
  tcscr |>
    transmute(
      bay_segment = as.character(bay_segment),
      yr = as.integer(yrs),
      indicator = 'tidal_creeks',
      outcome
    ),
  fibscr |>
    transmute(
      bay_segment = as.character(grp),
      yr = as.integer(yr),
      indicator = 'fib',
      outcome
    )
) |>
  filter(!is.na(outcome))
```

```{r}
# overall outcome by year and bay segment, averaged across whatever
# indicators have data for that segment/year. Restricted to OTB, HB, MTB,
# LTB (the four segments with the most complete indicator coverage) and to
# 2000 onward - by 2000, wq_attain/chla_thresh/la_thresh (from 1972-1974)
# and tn_load/hy_load (from 1985) are already available for all four
# segments every year, and fib (starting 2002/2003) and tidal_creeks'
# coverage of LTB (starting ~2005) both phase in shortly after. n_indicator
# tracks how many of the (up to 7) indicators fed each average, since a few
# early LTB years only have 5
wqoverall <- wqindic |>
  filter(bay_segment %in% c('OTB', 'HB', 'MTB', 'LTB'), yr >= 2000) |>
  group_by(bay_segment, yr) |>
  summarise(
    outcome = mean(outcome, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_indicator = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )
```
